licensure.disciplinary_grounds.rationale: These nine buckets capture the dominant clusters across all states: fraudulent licensure procurement, practice-quality failures (negligence/incompetence/misconduct), criminal convictions, improper seal/signature use, practicing without a valid license, substance abuse, reciprocal discipline from other jurisdictions, failure to comply with board rules/orders/reporting requirements, and broader professional ethics violations (dishonesty, conflicts of interest, advertising, unprofessional conduct) that don't fit the narrower practice-quality or fraud buckets.

profession_specific.seal_document_types.rationale: The items cluster naturally into graphic/design deliverables (plans, drawings, sketches), written technical requirements (specifications), analytical outputs (reports, studies, narratives), land-record documents (plats, maps, surveys), supporting technical work product (calculations, design information, estimates), construction-phase documents (construction documents, addenda, revisions, certifications), and broad omnibus terms (documents, work products, instruments of service, technical submissions) that several states use as catch-alls.

profession_specific.exemptions_from_lice.rationale: These ten buckets cover the dominant recurring exemption types across states: unlicensed staff working under PE supervision, federal and state/local government carve-outs, regulated utility/railroad/telecom employees, industrial/manufacturing in-house engineers, reciprocity-based temporary nonresident permits, size- or cost-threshold exemptions for small buildings, private property self-use exemptions, incidental practice by other licensed professions (architects, landscape architects, geologists), and contractors/construction trades executing or supervising licensed-engineer-designed work.
